_source: Protocol CTJ301UC201 v1.1 (16 May 2017), TJ301 IV in active ulcerative colitis. Values below are extracted from the protocol; items marked ASSUMED are not stated there and were chosen for the prototype.

stratification._note: prior_corticosteroids_prob is ASSUMED; protocol states only that randomisation is stratified by it

population._note: Inclusion: full Mayo >=5, rectal bleeding >=1, endoscopy >=2. Distribution across 5..12 is ASSUMED (centred ~8).

primary_endpoint.name: Clinical and endoscopic remission at Week 12
primary_endpoint.definition: full Mayo <=2, no subscore >1, rectal bleeding = 0

protocol_assumptions._note: Placebo 10% and 600 mg 40% are stated. 300 mg is not stated; 20% is ASSUMED so that pooled active = 30%, matching the protocol's 10% vs 30% pooled comparison.

_baseline_note: ASSUMED: each extra baseline Mayo point lowers odds of remission (OR ~0.78). Arm intercepts are calibrated so marginal rates equal the assumptions.

analysis.sample_size_method: Pearson chi-square without continuity correction, one-sided alpha 0.05
analysis.primary_model: logistic regression: treatment + prior corticosteroids + PK substudy + baseline full Mayo
